subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘CROSS’ is written as ‘66’ and ‘CHART’ is written as ‘90’. How will ‘SYMBOL’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Sum of the position values of immediate opposite letter according to the English alphabetic series are added to number of the digits within the word.

​​So,

 
• ‘CROSS’ is written as ‘66’
